manifest.title: Full-waveform inversion from a practitioner's start

params.survey: A 5 x 5 hammer grid (8 m) over a 9 x 9 geophone grid (4 m), vertical impacts

start.from: P1-02 surface travel times; Vs = Vp / sqrt(3)

params.optimiser: L-BFGS (memory 5), illumination preconditioner, 1-cell smoothing of the gradient, muted within 1.5-3 m of stations
params.misfit: L2 on the velocity records, traces within 4 m of their source excluded; stop at the noise level
params.inverse_crime: the full-band stage uses the grid and solver that made the records

finding: From uniform rock at the travel-time P speed and a textbook S speed, fitting the whole records to the noise level leaves the chamber at -16% in S speed (5.7x the scatter around it) and -2% in P speed; the background S speed moves from 1881 to 1866 m/s (true 1830).
